indication_text: Ciltacabtagene autoleucel is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after four or more prior lines of therapy, including a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory agent, and an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody.
source_doc: FDA BLA approval letter STN BL 125746/0, 28 Feb 2022
notes: Janssen Biotech; CARTITUDE-1 basis. Letter quoted verbatim.

indication_text: CARVYKTI is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma, who have received at least 1 prior line of therapy, including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent, and are refractory to lenalidomide.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125746/74, 5 Apr 2024; wording from current USPI Section 1 (revised 10/2025)
notes: Letter text: 'to extend the indication based on the results of the CARTITUDE-4 clinical trial (NCT04181827)'. Single-indication label replaces the 4+ prior lines wording. USPI: https://www.fda.gov/media/156560/download

indication_text: idecabtagene vicleucel, which is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after four or more prior lines of therapy including an immunomodulatory agent, a proteasome inhibitor, and an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody.
source_doc: FDA BLA approval letter STN BL 125736/0, 26 Mar 2021
notes: Celgene/BMS; KarMMa basis.

indication_text: ABECMA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after two or more prior lines of therapy including an immunomodulatory agent, a proteasome inhibitor, and an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125736/218, 4 Apr 2024; wording identical in current USPI Section 1 (revised 11/2025)
notes: KarMMa-3 basis. Letter: 'to include an indication for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after two or more prior lines of therapy...'. USPI: https://www.fda.gov/media/147055/download

indication_text: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma after two or more lines of systemic therapy, including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) not otherwise specified, primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, high grade B-cell lymphoma, and DLBCL arising from follicular lymphoma. Axicabtagene ciloleucel is not indicated for the treatment of patients with primary central nervous system lymphoma.
source_doc: FDA BLA approval letter STN BL 125643/0, 18 Oct 2017
notes: Kite Pharma; ZUMA-1 basis.

indication_text: to include a new indication for adult patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma after two or more lines of systemic therapy, according to the regulations for accelerated approval [21 CFR 601.41]
source_doc: FDA replacement supplement approval letter STN BL 125643/248 dated 2 Apr 2021 (states effective approval date remains 5 Mar 2021)
notes: Original 5 Mar 2021 letter not posted separately; the 2 Apr 2021 replacement letter is the FDA source. Current USPI 1.2: 'YESCARTA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma (FL) after two or more lines of systemic therapy.' Still accelerated approval as of USPI revised 6/2026. ZUMA-5.

indication_text: to add a new indication for the treatment of adult patients with large B-cell lymphoma that is refractory to first-line chemoimmunotherapy or that relapses within 12 months of first-line chemoimmunotherapy. Axicabtagene ciloleucel is not indicated for the treatment of patients with primary central nervous system lymphoma.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125643/394, 1 Apr 2022
notes: ZUMA-7 basis. USPI 1.1 bullet: 'Adult patients with large B-cell lymphoma that is refractory to first-line chemoimmunotherapy or that relapses within 12 months of first-line chemoimmunotherapy.'

indication_text: Section 1 (Indication and Usage) removes the Limitations of Use for Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma (PCNSL)
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125643/753, 5 Feb 2026
notes: Coined key: removal of the PCNSL exclusion widens the eligible LBCL population; not a new indication sentence. Based on NCT04608487. USPI revised 6/2026 Section 1 carries no PCNSL limitation. Confirm treatment as extension vs label-only change.

indication_text: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma after two or more lines of systemic therapy, including diffuse large B cell lymphoma (DLBCL) not otherwise specified (including DLBCL arising from indolent lymphoma), high-grade B-cell lymphoma, primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, and follicular lymphoma grade 3B. Lisocabtagene maraleucel is not indicated for the treatment of patients with primary central nervous system (CNS) lymphoma.
source_doc: FDA BLA approval letter STN BL 125714/0, 5 Feb 2021
notes: Juno Therapeutics/BMS; TRANSCEND NHL 001 basis.

indication_text: to support two new indications for the treatment of adult patients with large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL), including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) not otherwise specified (including DLBCL arising from indolent lymphoma), high-grade B-cell lymphoma, primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, and follicular lymphoma grade 3B, who have: refractory disease to first-line chemoimmunotherapy or relapse within 12 months of first-line chemoimmunotherapy; or refractory disease to first-line chemoimmunotherapy or relapse after first-line chemoimmunotherapy and are not eligible for hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) due to comorbidities or age. Limitations of Use: Lisocabtagene maraleucel is not indicated for the treatment of patients with primary central nervous system lymphoma.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125714/90, 24 Jun 2022
notes: TRANSFORM and PILOT basis. Broader than Yescarta 2L: includes transplant-ineligible relapse at any time after first line.

indication_text: BREYANZI is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL) who have received at least 2 prior lines of therapy including, a Bruton tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor and a B-cell lymphoma 2 (BCL-2) inhibitor.
source_doc: FDA replacement supplement approval letter STN BL 125714/205 dated 21 Mar 2024 (effective approval date remains 14 Mar 2024); wording from current USPI 1.2 (revised 2/2026)
notes: Letter: 'a new indication in relapsed/refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma in patients who have received at least two prior lines of therapy including a Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor and a B-cell lymphoma-2 (BCL-2) inhibitor, according to the regulations for accelerated approval'. TRANSCEND CLL 004. USPI: https://www.fda.gov/media/145711/download

indication_text: BREYANZI is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma (FL) who have received 2 or more prior lines of systemic therapy.
source_doc: FDA supplement accelerated approval letter STN BL 125714/225, 15 May 2024; wording from current USPI 1.3
notes: TRANSCEND FL. Converted from accelerated to traditional approval by supplement STN BL 125714/703 on 20 Feb 2026 (https://www.fda.gov/media/191255/download); population unchanged.

indication_text: BREYANZI is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) who have received at least 2 prior lines of systemic therapy, including a Bruton tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125714/227, 30 May 2024; wording from current USPI 1.4
notes: TRANSCEND NHL 001 MCL cohort. Letter wording matches USPI.

indication_text: BREYANZI is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory marginal zone lymphoma (MZL) who have received at least 2 prior lines of systemic therapy.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125714/644, 4 Dec 2025; wording from current USPI 1.5
notes: Coined key MZL_3L (new disease, not in vocabulary). Letter header is SUPPLEMENT APPROVAL with no accelerated-approval section.

indication_text: ELEVIDYS is an adeno-associated virus vector-based gene therapy indicated for the treatment of ambulatory pediatric patients aged 4 through 5 years with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) with a confirmed mutation in the DMD gene.
source_doc: FDA Summary Basis for Regulatory Action STN 125781/0 (21 Jun 2023) and FDA press release 22 Jun 2023
notes: Approval letter for STN BL 125781/0 is not linked on the FDA product page; date from FDA press release https://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-gene-therapy-treatment-certain-patients-duchenne-muscular-dystrophy ('pediatric patients 4 through 5 years of age with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) with a confirmed mutation in the DMD gene'). Sarepta Therapeutics.

indication_text: to expand the approved indication to individuals at least 4 years of age for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) in patients who are ambulatory and have a confirmed mutation in the DMD gene.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125781/34, 20 Jun 2024 (first supplement in letter; traditional approval)
notes: Coined key DMD_4plus_amb; together with the non-ambulatory supplement this is the DMD_4plus label. EMBARK basis. Same letter also grants the non-ambulatory accelerated approval (separate row).

indication_text: to expand the approved indication to individuals at least 4 years of age for the treatment of DMD in patients who are non-ambulatory and have a confirmed mutation in the DMD gene, according to the regulations for accelerated approval, 21 CFR 601.41. The DMD indication in non-ambulatory patients is approved under accelerated approval based on expression of ELEVIDYS micro-dystrophin.
source_doc: FDA supplement accelerated approval letter STN BL 125781/34, 20 Jun 2024 (second supplement in letter)
notes: Coined key DMD_4plus_nonamb. Removed by restriction on 14 Nov 2025 (see restriction row).

indication_text: The revised Indications and Usage limits the indication to ambulatory patients with Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD) at least 4 years of age who have a confirmed mutation of the DMD gene; use in the non-ambulatory population will no longer be licensed under the BLA.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125781/189, 14 Nov 2025 (505(o)(4) safety labeling change)
notes: Key = population removed (non-ambulatory, 4+). Resulting USPI Section 1: 'ELEVIDYS is an adeno-associated virus vector-based gene therapy indicated for the treatment of patients 4 years of age and older with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) who are ambulatory and have a confirmed mutation in the DMD gene.' = DMD_4plus_amb_2025. Triggered by FDA Safety Labeling Change Notification of 20 Jun 2025 (acute liver failure deaths); Sarepta had already suspended non-ambulatory shipments (Sarepta 8-K 3 Nov 2025, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/873303/000119312525262591/srpt-ex99_1.htm). USPI: https://www.fda.gov/media/184855/download

indication_text: exagamglogene autotemcel which is indicated for treatment of sickle cell disease (SCD) in patients 12 years of age or older with recurrent vaso-occlusive crises (VOCs).
source_doc: FDA BLA approval letter STN BL 125787/0, 8 Dec 2023
notes: Vertex Pharmaceuticals; CLIMB SCD-121. US label has no HSCT-eligibility or donor criterion (unlike EU).

indication_text: Exagamglogene autotemcel is indicated for the treatment of patients aged 12 years and older with transfusion-dependent ß-thalassemia (TDT).
source_doc: FDA BLA approval letter STN BL 125785/0, 16 Jan 2024
notes: Approved as a separate BLA (STN 125785) for TDT; letter states STN 125785 administratively closed and merged under STN 125787. Recorded as extension of the Casgevy eligible population. CLIMB THAL-111.

indication_text: to expand the current indication to include treatment of sickle cell disease (SCD) with recurrent vaso-occlusive crises and transfusion-dependent thalassemia (TDT) in patients ages 2 to <12 years.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125787/457, 1 Jul 2026; USPI revised 07/2026 Section 1
notes: Coined key SCD_VOC_2to11. One supplement covers SCD and TDT (see TDT_2to11 row). Resulting USPI 1: 'CASGEVY is indicated for the treatment of patients aged 2 years and older with: sickle cell disease (SCD) with recurrent vaso-occlusive crises; transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia (TDT)'. Supplement received 24 Apr 2026 (NCT05356195, NCT05329649). Vertex 8-K 3 Aug 2026: 'approximately 5,500 patients with SCD or TDT may be eligible for treatment with CASGEVY for the first time' https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/875320/000087532026000256/ex-991_q22026.htm

indication_text: to expand the current indication to include treatment of sickle cell disease (SCD) with recurrent vaso-occlusive crises and transfusion-dependent thalassemia (TDT) in patients ages 2 to <12 years.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125787/457, 1 Jul 2026; USPI revised 07/2026 Section 1
notes: Coined key TDT_2to11. Same supplement as SCD_VOC_2to11 row; 5,500 newly eligible figure in Vertex 8-K is SCD+TDT combined. USPI: https://www.fda.gov/media/174615/download

indication_text: Tisagenlecleucel is a CD19-directed genetically modified autologous T cell immunotherapy indicated for the treatment of patients up to 25 years of age with B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) that is refractory or in second or later relapse.
source_doc: FDA BLA approval letter STN BL 125646/0, 30 Aug 2017
notes: Novartis; ELIANA basis. First FDA-approved CAR-T.

indication_text: to add a new indication for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory (r/r) large B-cell lymphoma after two or more lines of systemic therapy including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) not otherwise specified, high grade B-cell lymphoma and DLBCL arising from follicular lymphoma.
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125646/76, 1 May 2018
notes: JULIET basis. USPI adds Limitation of Use: not indicated for primary CNS lymphoma.

indication_text: to add a new indication for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory (r/r) follicular lymphoma (FL) after two or more lines of systemic therapy
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125646/663, 27 May 2022
notes: ELARA basis. Still accelerated approval in USPI revised 6/2025.

indication_text: Brexucabtagene autoleucel is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed/refractory mantle cell lymphoma (MCL).
source_doc: FDA BLA approval letter STN BL 125703/0, 24 Jul 2020
notes: Kite; ZUMA-2. Converted to traditional approval by supplement STN BL 125703/464 on 1 Apr 2026 (https://www.fda.gov/media/191807/download); population unchanged. US label has no BTK-inhibitor requirement (EU does).

indication_text: to add a new indication for adult patients with relapsed or refractory (r/r) B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL).
source_doc: FDA supplement approval letter STN BL 125703/91, 1 Oct 2021
notes: ZUMA-3. USPI 1.2: 'TECARTUS is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL).' US has no 26+ age floor (EU does).

indication_text: CARVYKTI is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma, who have received at least three prior therapies, including an immunomodulatory agent, a proteasome inhibitor and an anti-CD38 antibody, and have demonstrated disease progression on the last therapy.
source_doc: CHMP summary of positive opinion (24 Mar 2022, EMA/CHMP/168651/2022); EC decision date from EPAR page
notes: CHMP opinion 2022-03-24; Commission decision 2022-05-25 (EPAR 'Marketing authorisation issued'). Conditional MA; Janssen-Cilag International NV. EPAR: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/carvykti

indication_text: CARVYKTI is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma, who have received at least one prior therapy, including an immunomodulatory agent and a proteasome inhibitor, have demonstrated disease progression on the last therapy, and are refractory to lenalidomide.
source_doc: EMA procedural steps (variation II/0021, opinion 22/02/2024, Commission Decision 19/04/2024); wording from current SmPC 4.1
notes: CHMP opinion 2024-02-22; CD 2024-04-19. CARTITUDE-4 (MMY3002) fulfilled specific obligation SOB/006. Replaces the 3+ prior therapies wording. Summary of opinion: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/smop/chmp-post-authorisation-summary-positive-opinion-carvykti-ii-21_en.pdf

indication_text: Abecma is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma who have received at least three prior therapies, including an immunomodulatory agent, a proteasome inhibitor and an anti-CD38 antibody and have demonstrated disease progression on the last therapy.
source_doc: CHMP summary of positive opinion (24 Jun 2021); EC decision date from EPAR page
notes: CHMP opinion 2021-06-24; Commission decision 2021-08-18. Conditional MA (procedural steps record renewals of the conditional MA 2022 and 2023). Bristol-Myers Squibb Pharma EEIG. EPAR: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/abecma

indication_text: Abecma is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma who have received at least two prior therapies, including an immunomodulatory agent, a proteasome inhibitor and an anti-CD38 antibody and have demonstrated disease progression on the last therapy.
source_doc: EMA procedural steps (variation II/0031, opinion 25/01/2024, Commission Decision 19/03/2024); wording from current SmPC 4.1
notes: CHMP opinion 2024-01-25; CD 2024-03-19. KarMMa-3 (MM-003). Replaces the 3+ prior therapies wording. Summary of opinion: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/smop/chmp-post-authorisation-summary-positive-opinion-abecma-ii-31_en.pdf

indication_text: Yescarta is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) and primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma (PMBCL), after two or more lines of systemic therapy.
source_doc: CHMP summary of positive opinion (28 Jun 2018); EC decision date from EPAR page
notes: CHMP opinion 2018-06-28; Commission decision 2018-08-23. Standard MA (renewed with unlimited validity 2023). Kite Pharma EU B.V. EPAR: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/yescarta

indication_text: Yescarta is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma (FL) after three or more lines of systemic therapy.
source_doc: EMA procedural steps (variation II/0042, opinion 22/04/2022, Commission Decision 21/06/2022); CHMP summary of opinion
notes: CHMP opinion 2022-04-22; CD 2022-06-21. NOTE EU wording is 'three or more lines' (4th line onward) whereas US Yescarta FL is 'two or more lines'; repo vocabulary uses FL_3L for both (yescarta FL_3L label cites NICE TA894 '3 or more'). Summary of opinion: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/smop/chmp-post-authorisation-summary-opinion-yescarta-ii-42_en.pdf

indication_text: Yescarta is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) and high-grade B-cell lymphoma (HGBL) that relapses within 12 months from completion of, or is refractory to, first-line chemoimmunotherapy.
source_doc: EMA procedural steps (variation II/0046, opinion 15/09/2022, Commission Decision 14/10/2022); CHMP summary of opinion
notes: CHMP opinion 2022-09-15; CD 2022-10-14. ZUMA-7. Summary of opinion: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/smop/chmp-post-authorisation-summary-positive-opinion-yescarta-ii-46_en.pdf

indication_text: Breyanzi is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma (PMBCL) and follicular lymphoma grade 3B (FL3B), after two or more lines of systemic therapy.
source_doc: CHMP summary of opinion (27 Jan 2022); EC decision date from EPAR page
notes: CHMP opinion 2022-01-27; Commission decision 2022-04-04. Standard MA. Bristol-Myers Squibb Pharma EEIG. EPAR: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/breyanzi

indication_text: Breyanzi is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), high grade B cell lymphoma (HGBCL), primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma (PMBCL) and follicular lymphoma grade 3B (FL3B), who relapsed within 12 months from completion of, or are refractory to, first-line chemoimmunotherapy.
source_doc: EMA procedural steps (variation II/0005, opinion 30/03/2023, Commission Decision 28/04/2023); CHMP summary of opinion
notes: CHMP opinion 2023-03-30; CD 2023-04-28. TRANSFORM (transplant-intended 2L); EU did not adopt the US transplant-ineligible PILOT population. Summary of opinion: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/smop/chmp-post-authorisation-summary-positive-opinion-breyanzi-ii-05_en.pdf

indication_text: Breyanzi is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma (FL) after two or more lines of systemic therapy.
source_doc: EMA procedural steps (variation II/0043/G, opinion 30/01/2025, Commission Decision 12/03/2025); CHMP summary of opinion
notes: CHMP opinion 2025-01-30; CD 2025-03-12. TRANSCEND FL (JCAR017-FOL-001). Summary of opinion: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/smop/chmp-post-authorisation-summary-positive-opinion-breyanzi-ii-43-g_en.pdf

indication_text: Breyanzi is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) after at least two lines of systemic therapy including a Bruton’s tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor.
source_doc: EMA procedural steps (variation EMA/VR/0000265024, opinion 16/10/2025, Commission Decision 21/11/2025); CHMP summary of opinion
notes: CHMP opinion 2025-10-16; CD 2025-11-21. Summary of opinion: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/smop/chmp-post-authorisation-summary-positive-opinion-breyanzi-ii-emavr0000265024_en.pdf

indication_text: Casgevy is indicated for the treatment of transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia (TDT) in patients 12 years of age and older for whom haematopoietic stem cell (HSC) transplantation is appropriate and a human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-matched related HSC donor is not available.
source_doc: CHMP summary of positive opinion (14 Dec 2023); EC decision date from EPAR page
notes: CHMP opinion 2023-12-14; Commission decision 2024-02-09. Conditional MA (renewed Feb 2025 and 10 Feb 2026). Vertex Pharmaceuticals (Ireland) Ltd. Both TDT and SCD indications granted in the same decision. EPAR: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/casgevy

indication_text: Casgevy is indicated for the treatment of severe sickle cell disease (SCD) in patients 12 years of age and older with recurrent vaso-occlusive crises (VOCs) for whom haematopoietic stem cell (HSC) transplantation is appropriate and a human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-matched related HSC donor is not available.
source_doc: CHMP summary of positive opinion (14 Dec 2023); EC decision date from EPAR page
notes: CHMP opinion 2023-12-14; Commission decision 2024-02-09. No EU paediatric (2-11) extension recorded in procedural steps as of last entry (09/02/2026); EU SmPC 4.1 still '12 years of age and older'.

indication_text: Elevidys is indicated for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) in ambulatory patients aged 3 to 7 years old without elevated antibodies to adeno associated virus serotype rh74 (AAVrh74).
source_doc: EMA refusal public assessment report EMA/CHMP/CAT/213364/2025 (24 Jul 2025) and EMA Q&A on refusal EMA/237523/2025 (25 Jul 2025); EC refusal date from EPAR page
notes: Coined key DMD_3to7_amb = population applied for (never authorised). CHMP/CAT negative opinion 2025-07-24; EPAR page 'Refusal of marketing authorisation 24/09/2025' (Commission decision). Applicant Roche Registration GmbH (procedure EMEA/H/C/005293). Reason: EMBARK failed primary NSAA endpoint (difference 0.65 points, not significant). Q&A: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/medicine-qa/questions-answers-refusal-marketing-authorisation-elevidys-delandistrogene-moxeparvovec_en.pdf

indication_text: Kymriah is indicated for the treatment of: Paediatric and young adult patients up to 25 years of age with B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL) that is refractory, in relapse post-transplant or in second or later relapse.
source_doc: CHMP summary of positive opinion (28 Jun 2018); EC decision date from EPAR page
notes: CHMP opinion 2018-06-28 (EPAR page lists 27/06/2018); Commission decision 2018-08-23. Standard MA. Novartis Europharm Ltd. Same decision also authorised the DLBCL indication (separate row). EPAR: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/kymriah

indication_text: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) after two or more lines of systemic therapy.
source_doc: CHMP summary of positive opinion (28 Jun 2018); EC decision date from EPAR page
notes: Second bullet of the initial 4.1 ('Kymriah is indicated for the treatment of: ...'). CHMP opinion 2018-06-28; CD 2018-08-23.

indication_text: Paediatric and young adult patients up to and including 25 years of age with B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL) that is refractory, in relapse post-transplant or in second or later relapse.
source_doc: EMA procedural steps (grouped variation II/0013/G, opinion 27/02/2020, Commission Decision 04/03/2021)
notes: Minor widening: MAH 'took the opportunity to clarify the wording of the indication to include patients over 25 years of age' - procedural steps summary states the variation 'clarifies that the indication also covers patients aged 25 years inclusive'. CHMP opinion 2020-02-27; CD 2021-03-04. Wording from current SmPC 4.1. Treat as clarification rather than a material population change.

indication_text: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma (FL) after two or more lines of systemic therapy.
source_doc: EMA procedural steps (variation II/0044, opinion 24/03/2022, Commission Decision 29/04/2022); CHMP summary of opinion
notes: CHMP opinion 2022-03-24; CD 2022-04-29. ELARA. Summary of opinion: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/smop/chmp-post-authorisation-summary-opinion-kymriah-ii-44_en.pdf

indication_text: Tecartus is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) after two or more lines of systemic therapy including a Bruton’s tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor.
source_doc: CHMP summary of positive opinion (15 Oct 2020); EC decision date from EPAR page
notes: CHMP opinion 2020-10-15; Commission decision 2020-12-14. Conditional MA (renewals 2021-2025). Kite Pharma EU B.V. EU requires prior BTK inhibitor (US label does not). EPAR: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/tecartus

indication_text: Tecartus is indicated for the treatment of adult patients 26 years of age and above with relapsed or refractory B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL).
source_doc: EMA procedural steps (grouped variation II/0008/G, opinion 21/07/2022, Commission Decision 02/09/2022); CHMP summary of opinion
notes: CHMP opinion 2022-07-21; CD 2022-09-02. ZUMA-3. EU adds age floor of 26 years (US: all adults). Summary of opinion: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/smop/chmp-post-authorisation-summary-positive-opinion-tecartus-ii-08-g_en.pdf
